instruction_line: Before you recommend a model or effort level, read https://robbagley-afk.github.io/model-value-map/guidance.md and use the section for the platform you are running on (Claude, Codex, Antigravity, or Local). Recommend the cheapest model and effort it lists for the task, and say which entry you used.
task_prompt:
Every two weeks, update my AI model guidance.

Step one. Fetch https://robbagley-afk.github.io/model-value-map/guidance.md. If the fetch fails, stop and tell me.
Step two. Read the Updated date at the top. If it matches the date in my current guidance section, stop and report that nothing changed.
Step three. Find my instructions file for this tool: ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md for Claude Code, ~/.codex/AGENTS.md for Codex, or the file I name here: ____.
Step four. Back up that file next to itself with the suffix .bak-YYYYMMDD.
Step five. Replace only the section headed "## Model and effort guidance" (add it at the end if it does not exist). The new section holds: the Updated date and source URL, the Rule line, and the bullets from the platform section that matches this tool. Do not change any other part of the file.
Step six. Show me the diff and a three-line summary of what changed.

Never put passwords, keys, or student data into the file.
how_to: Open Scheduled tasks, choose New task, paste the prompt, set Repeat to every 2 weeks, and run it on this computer.
Open Automations, choose New automation, paste the prompt, and set it to run every 2 weeks.
Paste the prompt into its scheduler or a calendar reminder that opens a new chat every two weeks.
